formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Modelling Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on C4.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can ask a math question, collect data, and predict.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can ask a math question, collect data, and predict.
header.character_watermark: Maple in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Look at the picture. Write 1 math question about it.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. A picture box plus a question line.

image_placeholders.description: A small B&W line-art sugar bush picture with 4 trees, ~6in x 2in. Below: 'My math question: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_PICTURE: keywords (math, question) name what the slot asks for.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Must be countable (e.g., 'How many trees?').

prompts.prompt: Count and record. Use the data table.
prompts.visual_layout: Middle of page. A 4-row data table.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row data table in B&W on a portrait page. Pre-filled left column: TREES, BUCKETS, TAPS, JARS. Right column blank for counts.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_DATA: keywords (data, count) name what the table asks for.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Each row should have a number.

prompts.prompt: Predict: if 1 tree gives 1 bucket, how many buckets do you predict for 6 trees?

image_placeholders.description: A prediction slot in B&W, ~6in x 0.7in. Format: 'My prediction: ___ buckets'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_PREDICT: keywords (prediction, buckets) name what the line asks for.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three faces in a row labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, and TRY AGAIN.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row in B&W. Smile labelled GOT IT, neutral labelled ALMOST, frown labelled TRY AGAIN.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q4_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: question countable + data recorded + prediction reasonable = ready for Lesson 4 (refine/reflect).

reflection_sheet.title: My Modelling Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Maple holding a Junior Modeller certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Modeller? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. Three star-rating ovals.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Modeller!'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 5-row YES/NO table in B&W. Rows: 'I asked a math question', 'I collected data', 'I made a prediction', 'I refined my model', 'I shared my model'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE modelling step?

image_placeholders.description: Five icons in B&W: situation, question, data table, prediction, reflection. Each ~1in x 1in with selection bubble. Labels below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the five options.

prompts.visual_layout: Lower-middle. Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Asking the right question', 'Refining my rule', 'Choosing a topic'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to model NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Something at home', 'Something at school', 'Something outside'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5 after the certificate ceremony.
